title: SS27 Toddler Girls' Trim Stories
summary: Trims for each toddler girls theme.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" swimwear runs from vintage pink to pastel green and soft navy, in technical fabrics including sustainable lycra, with UV protection<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Little Meadow
sections.body: - Embroidery with soft backing, covered buttons.

design_implications:
- One trim family per theme.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.

sources.title: Slow living: run, dive, play, the summer wardrobe (Pitti Bimbo 103 exhibitors)
